name: Sauna Heater Size Table
generated_by: build.js from heater.js (Sauna Heater Size Calculator, MIT)
caution: Rule-of-thumb sizing from heater makers' published rules. Always confirm with the heater manufacturer and a licensed electrician.

columns.name: room_volume_m3
columns.description: Room volume, length x width x height inside, in m³. Rows run 3 to 30.

columns.name: room_volume_cuft
columns.description: The same volume in cubic feet (1 m³ = 35.3147 cu ft), rounded.

columns.name: uninsulated_area_m2
columns.description: Area of glass, stone, tile, brick or concrete with no insulation behind it, m²: 0, 1, 2, 3 or 4.

columns.name: uninsulated_area_sqft
columns.description: The same area in square feet (1 m² = 10.7639 sq ft).

columns.name: log_walls
columns.description: true if the inside walls are bare log (Harvia: room volume x 1.5).

columns.name: harvia_calc_volume_m3
columns.description: Calculated volume by Harvia: room volume (x 1.5 for log) + 1.2 m³ per m² of uninsulated area.

columns.name: kw_low
columns.description: Low end of the electric heater power: 1 kW per 50 cu ft of Harvia calculated volume (retail shortcut, matches Harvia's 8.5 m³ example).

columns.name: kw_high
columns.description: High end: 1 kW per m³ of Harvia calculated volume (Harvia and HUUM average).

columns.name: huum_calc_volume_m3
columns.description: Calculated volume by HUUM: room volume + 1 m³ per m² of uninsulated area. Null for log walls (HUUM uses area, not a factor).

columns.name: huum_kw
columns.description: HUUM rule: 1 kW per calculated m³.

columns.name: huum_na_calc_volume_m3
columns.description: Calculated volume by the North American "Sizing Your HUUM" sheet: 4.92 cu ft per sq ft (1.5 m³ per m²). Null for log walls.

columns.name: huum_na_kw
columns.description: The same at 1 kW per calculated m³.
